sample_scope.stub_contract: every dictionary variable and V call evaluates to number 1

limitations: V_CUR/V_PRE/V_EXT retrieval is stubbed with deterministic number-1 values; real retrieval semantics belong to the rule engine service slice.
Evidence merging is exercised only with empty evidence in the cross-language run; merge order is covered by Rust unit tests.
The decimal mode uses an internal digit-vector decimal with a 28-significant-digit context; Python decimal values that overflow the working range fail with an explicit error.
